sections.title: Direct observation of electron shedding from a laser-plasma accelerator
sections.abstract: The authors report direct observation of a high-charge electron bunch expanding after laser-plasma acceleration and progressively shedding electrons during extraction.
sections.claimed_result: Collective extraction dynamics transfer energy into a low-energy tail and reduce useful peak charge density.
sections.caveat: The abstract does not quantify generality across accelerator regimes.

sections.title: Less isn't more: Cosmological bounds on the neutrino masses are robust to changes in the neutrino abundance
sections.abstract: MCMC analyses find altered neutrino abundance changes cosmological neutrino-mass limits only modestly.
sections.claimed_result: The reported 95% degenerate-ordering limit spans 0.0652–0.0724 eV across tested scenarios.
sections.caveat: The result depends on cosmological parameterization, data combination, and assumed mass splittings.

sections.title: Stripe-Like Superconducting Enhancement and Coexisting Magnetic Texture in an Infinite Layer Nickelate
sections.abstract: Scanning SQUID imaging reveals magnetic texture coexisting with superconductivity and stripe-like enhancement near the transition.
sections.claimed_result: A competing magnetic phase may contribute to broad transitions in nickelate films.
sections.caveat: The abstract reports correlation, not proof of causation, and the result is sample-specific.

sections.title: Distinguishing cosmology, astrophysics and systematics: the Bayesian search for a primordial gravitational-wave background in next-generation observatories
sections.abstract: Simulations show Cosmic Explorer can recover a cosmological background amid binary-black-hole foregrounds, but waveform systematics can bias inference.
sections.claimed_result: A signal-to-noise 5 background is recovered in one simulated day; low-frequency mismatch can create a false background.
sections.caveat: This is a simulation forecast, not a detection.

sections.title: Strong-coupling quantum optics in free space with holes in a Fermi sea
sections.abstract: The authors propose a wavepacket antenna that produces directional free-space atom–light coupling.
sections.claimed_result: Predicted single-atom cooperativity can approach cavity/waveguide-QED performance.
sections.caveat: Required motional-state control and scattering geometry remain to be demonstrated.

sections.title: First Observation and Dynamical Study of the Ds to f0(980) mu nu Decay
sections.abstract: BESIII reports the first observation of the semileptonic decay and a lepton-flavor-universality-consistent ratio.
sections.claimed_result: Using 7.33 fb^-1, it measures the branching fraction as (1.59±0.18_stat±0.11_syst)×10^-3.
sections.caveat: The form-factor extraction depends on a pole parametrization and external |Vcs| input.

sections.title: Shot noise signatures of Majorana-assisted transport in an Aharonov-Bohm interferometer
sections.abstract: Nonequilibrium calculations predict current, shot-noise, and Fano-factor signatures of Majorana-assisted transport.
sections.claimed_result: Half-flux destructive interference can enhance visibility of the predicted signal.
sections.caveat: The indirect signatures can be mimicked by non-Majorana mechanisms.

sections.title: Neutron Skin Effects on Particle Emission in Heavy-Ion Collisions: A Topic Review with Astrophysical and Nuclear Structure Connections
sections.abstract: The review connects neutron-skin structure to heavy-ion observables, symmetry energy, nuclear measurements, and neutron stars.
sections.claimed_result: It argues that joint reaction, nuclear-structure, and astrophysical information is needed to constrain symmetry energy.
sections.caveat: The synthesis is model-sensitive and presents no new measurement.
